sloka: प्रेष्याश्चेष्ट्यश्च वध्वश्च बलस्थाश्च सहस्रश: ।बभूवुस्ऺते भृशं दृप्ता: सर्वे चाहतवासस: ॥ २.९१.६३॥
transliteration: preṣyāśceṣṭyaśca vadhvaśca balasthāśca sahasraśa: ।babhūvusऺte bhṛśaṁ dṛptā: sarve cāhatavāsasa: ॥ 2.91.63॥

translations.english: Those thousands of soldiers wearing flower garlands ran about dancing, singing, and laughing.
